messages:
Nina: Quick sync 1.0.1 rollout tomorrow 07:00 PT. Need final internal blurb + rollback owners.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: r-2026-04-05-07. Canary -> phased -> global. Set embargo if needed.

Sam: Draft note at https://rwd.co/s/21.0.1-internal. Highlights: runtime GC fix, batcher latency improvements, internal pin to model v3.0. Keep public message generic.

Theo: I'll own rollback and the infra checklist. Rollback trigger: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 4m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 4m. Rollback cmd: `opsctl rollback --id r-2026-04-05-07 --to 21.0.0`.

Nina: Request embargo 06:45-08:15 PT to block unrelated changes. Also want internal post at 06:50 in #all-hands and pin to #eng-releases.

deploy-bot: Embargo set by @Nina for 06:45-08:15 PT.

Sam: Add runbook link and verification checklist to the internal note. I added smoke tests + a sample inference query.

Theo: I'll add tracing tags `release=21.0.1` and a short dashboard for the first 30m. Also set GPU mem alert at 80%.

Nina: Internal blurb draft: "Tomorrow 07:00 PT we will roll 21.0.1 (runtime + model pin). Brief canary window expected; no customer-facing downtime anticipated. Standby: Theo (rollback), Sam (SRE). Runbook attached." Cool to post at 06:50?

Sam: LGTM. Leave model specifics out of external comms.

Theo: Ready to standby. Will monitor 5xx and p95 and escalate to #incidents if needed.

Nina: Thanks all 64f. I'll post and pin at 06:50.
